for_each: SELECT id,reference FROM version_register ORDER BY reference
name: programme-specification
title: Programme specification working record

sections.title: Modules
sections.sql: SELECT code,title,level,credits,hours,aim,content,delivery FROM modules WHERE version_id=$1 ORDER BY code

sections.title: Programme outcomes
sections.sql: SELECT code,description FROM outcomes WHERE version_id=$1 AND module_id IS NULL ORDER BY code

sections.title: Assessment plan
sections.sql: SELECT m.code AS module,a.code,a.title,a.method,a.criteria,a.weight FROM assessments a JOIN modules m ON m.id=a.module_id WHERE a.version_id=$1 ORDER BY m.code,a.code

for_each: SELECT id,reference FROM version_register ORDER BY reference
name: mapping-matrix
title: Learning outcome mapping matrix

sections.title: Outcome alignment
sections.sql: SELECT m.code AS module,lo.code AS learning_outcome,lo.description,po.code AS programme_outcome,a.evidence FROM outcomes lo JOIN modules m ON m.id=lo.module_id LEFT JOIN alignments a ON a.learning_outcome_id=lo.id LEFT JOIN outcomes po ON po.id=a.programme_outcome_id WHERE lo.version_id=$1 ORDER BY m.code,lo.code,po.code

sections.title: Assessment coverage
sections.sql: SELECT o.code AS learning_outcome,a.code AS assessment,a.method,a.criteria FROM outcomes o LEFT JOIN assessment_outcomes ao ON ao.outcome_id=o.id LEFT JOIN assessments a ON a.id=ao.assessment_id WHERE o.version_id=$1 AND o.module_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o.code,a.code

for_each: SELECT id,reference FROM version_register ORDER BY reference
name: committee-pack
title: Academic review committee working pack

sections.title: Record checks
sections.note: A clean report does not mean regulatory approval. Review the curriculum substance and external evidence.
sections.sql: SELECT rule,finding FROM curriculum_findings WHERE version_id=$1 ORDER BY rule,finding

sections.title: Actions
sections.sql: SELECT owner,note,due,resolution,closed_at FROM tasks WHERE version_id=$1 ORDER BY due

sections.title: Recorded internal decisions
sections.sql: SELECT actor,decision,evidence,created_at FROM reviews WHERE version_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at
